decisionLog.decision: New-change discussion sessions are read-only only before scaffolding; after planning and explicit user authorization, the same session may implement the tracked change under normal task-state rules.
User authorized automatic continuation through Phases 3 and 4 after the Phase 2 verification gate passes; Phase 5 remains planned but not authorized.

For experimental OpenCode operations in Phases 2-4, lessmess will expose explicit capability-gated routes and visible unsupported states; it will not emulate missing operations or add a generic API proxy.

Service health must capability-detect current V2 /api/info and retain a narrow /api/health fallback: the installed beta service returns 404 for /api/info and 200 for /api/health, while the published 2.0.6 OpenAPI has /api/info only.

Lifecycle/management capability detection must be method-and-path based, not version-string based: the installed beta advertises legacy /revert/clear, /inbox/{id}/queue|steer, stable /session/{id}/skill, and non-experimental MCP mutations, while published 2.0.6 moved or replaced those paths.
